text:
Ava: Quick sync — we need a tighter set of competitive claims for the launch post + webinar. Aim: 3 hero soundbites, 2 bench narratives, and an SDR-ready battlecard.

Jonas: Initial thought list: 'Serving-first economics', 'Unified runtime across hosted/dedicated/private', 'Predictable latency with graceful fallbacks' — short bullets incoming.

Priya: Can we avoid saying 'cheaper' outright? Suggest phrasing: 'control unit cost via batching, caching, and quantization profiles' — more defensible.

Marta: Agree. For field rebuttals we should prep two quick callouts: 1) multi-region fallback (keeps apps online), 2) private deployment with KMS & audit logs for regulated customers.

Ava: 👍 Also, benchmark narrative needs to be careful: don't put raw numbers in the hero. Use structure: methodology -> workload archetypes -> headline: 'lower unit cost on steady chat workloads' and a note about 95/99 latency SLOs.

Jonas: Webinar plan: short bench methodology walkthrough, live demo showing canary rollback + routing policies, and panel Q&A on compliance. Who moderates?

Priya: Sarah from Product volunteered to moderate in the doc I updated. I'll draft a 5-slide script and a 1-min poll: "Which matters most: latency, cost, or control?"

Marta: Inbound routing: tag prospects into 3 buckets in Intercom — Demo, Dedicated interest (SLA/compliance), & Technical eval. Set 'Dedicated interest' to trigger SDR+solutions-eng follow-up.

Ava: For the battlecard, we need: one-liner rebuttals, 30s soundbites, and a tiny code snippet showing routing fallback. Example snippet we can include in the SDR playbook:

```
# routing policy (pseudocode)
if capacity['dedicated'] < threshold:
  route(request, model_variant='hosted-compatible')
else:
  route(request, model_variant='dedicated')
```

Jonas: Nice. Add objection handlers like: 'We already use cloud endpoints' -> 'Redwood gives a unified API + observability + predictable economics across environments' — short, non-technical rebuttal.

Priya: I'll produce 3 hero-copy options: 1) Dev DX angle, 2) Unit-economics angle, 3) Compliance/control angle. We can A/B test in the email subject lines.

Marta: Timeline check: deck + public one-pager by Tue EOD, webinar outline & logistics by Thu, SDR battlecard + Intercom routing rules by Friday. Ops to confirm any calendar conflicts.

launch-bot: Webinar landing page created -> /webinar/serving-first (auto-generated).

deploy-bot: Recording slot reserved on Thu 11:00 PT — ops confirmed.

Ava: Perfect. I'm dropping a tiny checklist below and will assign tasks in the doc: [ ] deck, [ ] one-pager, [ ] webinar script, [ ] routing rules, [ ] SDR playbook, [ ] bench writeup. Ping me if you need exact language for the public-facing bench.

Jonas: I'll take the bench writeup and the 'fallback examples' card.

Priya: Taking hero copies + subject lines.

Marta: I'll wire the Intercom tags and SDR handoff flow.

Ava: Thanks all — I'll consolidate and post the first draft into #marketing-drafts by EOD. :rocket:
